name: Private offline image browser and tagger

mentions.name: Private offline image browser and tagger
mentions.description: A desktop app for browsing, tagging, and rating image collections. It reads image files without modifying them, keeping all tags, ratings, and metadata in a local SQLite database, and works fully offline as a private, easy-to-use alternative to the Eagle app.
mentions.source_excerpt: A desktop app to easily browse, tag, and rate your images. It doesn't touch your files, it just reads them. Everything is stored in a local SQLite database. Think Eagle app but private, offline, and easy to use.
mentions.author: bbx
